column3: Grow a garden by feeding your gut
column4: Your gut hosts trillions of microbes, and variety is what they thrive on. Snap your meals and we turn them into a living garden — the more different plants you feed it, the more it grows, and the better it looks after you.
The week's plant count, the rainbow, and the 3 P's live here, with callouts for exactly what to eat today to fill the gaps. Thirty different plants a week is the goal — diversity, never restriction.

Prebiotic — fiber your microbes eat. Probiotic — live cultures from fermented foods. Polyphenol — the deep-colored plant compounds. One of each a day is a beautifully fed garden; tap the pill any time for your two-week trend.

Try this serves curated recipes with serving sizes. The ↻ deals a fresh idea; the target picks the meal that best fills today's gaps — fiber, plant variety, colors, phytonutrients — so you never quietly run low on any of them.
Point the camera at your plate — we identify the plants and feed your garden. No weighing, no typing. A note like "extra onion" catches what the camera can't see.
Every plant you eat joins a lifetime collection — plants, colors, phytochemicals, fermented finds. Rarer finds are a bigger deal.
No number in week one — we watch how you actually eat first. Explore 30 plants and the goal unlocks at a level that's comfortable for you, then rises gently as you're ready, water reminders included.

column3: You teach us, we teach you
column4: Eat freely. The optional check-in plus a quiet guardian notice what sits well and what doesn't — and always ask before flagging anything. Over time we steer you toward foods that make you feel good, and around the ones that don't.
Track as much or as little as you like — customize exactly what the check-in asks, right here in You. Your picks shape your trends too.
These crews stand for the microbes you're feeding. Each one runs on different plants — feed a crew steadily for a few days and it blooms.
The garden grows in worlds: bloom the Core's crews and new districts open up. It's a living map of your gut's diversity, drawn from what you actually eat.
Nourishment fades a little each day, so steady feeding beats one big plate. Every crew's page tells you exactly what it runs on.
Six color groups, each carrying its own phytochemicals. Any amount counts toward the week's six — a ring closes fully when you eat a lot of that color, and the outline shows how much is left to fill.
Each color's page shows its week, example foods, and what it does for you — the fastest way to answer "what should I add today?"
Every new plant you eat joins your collection for life — rarer finds are a bigger deal. Tap any plant to read its story.
Fermented foods bring live cultures — the probiotic P. A little each day is a lovely habit, and each find is collected here.
The compounds behind the colors — your microbes turn them into useful things. The coverage bars show how much of the catalogue you've eaten this week, fortnight, and month.
Tap a coverage bar to see exactly which compounds you haven't had lately — each one lists the foods that carry it.

Fast-fermenting fibers get devoured by your microbes within hours; slower ones burn all day. Fast fuel grows the garden quickest — and makes the most gas while your crews scale up. These charts show your mix.
Feed a crew steadily and it grows capacity — meals that felt lively a month ago sit quietly once the microbes that eat them multiply. Slow, steady increases are the whole trick.
Customise your daily check-in and watch mood, energy, and clarity move against your starting baseline.
